title: 집 구하기와 관리: 계약서, 보증금, 관리비
objective: You can use 10 words about leases, rent, and building management in short sentences.
summary: This worksheet teaches key Korean words for renting a home, from signing the lease to paying building fees.

task.title: Choose and fill in
task.line: Read each situation and choose or write the word from this worksheet that fits best.

words.meaning: lease contract (the written agreement for renting a home)
words.example: 계약서에 도장을 찍기 전에 꼼꼼히 읽어 보세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Read the lease carefully before you stamp it.

words.example: 이사 나갈 때 보증금을 다 돌려받았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I got my whole deposit back when I moved out.

words.example: 학교 근처 원룸은 월세가 비싼 편이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: Studio apartments near the school tend to have high monthly rent.

words.meaning: jeonse lease (you pay one large deposit and no monthly rent)
words.example: 전세로 살면 매달 월세를 안 내도 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you live on a jeonse lease, you don't have to pay rent every month.
You have to pay the maintenance fee separately from the rent.

words.meaning: facilities (equipment and shared spaces in a building)
words.exampleMeaning: This building is old, but the facilities are clean.
It took a week to fix the air conditioner.
I liked the place, so I extended the lease for a year.

words.meaning: to move into (a new home or building)
words.example: 새 아파트에 다음 달에 입주할 예정이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to move into the new apartment next month.
Please leave the package at the management office.

exercises: Choose 월세 or 전세 for each blank: ① 매달 50만 원씩 ____를 내요. ② 큰돈을 맡기고 2년 동안 ____로 살아요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 수리하다: 화장실 문이 안 닫혀요. 내일 기사님이 와서 ____ 줄 거예요.
Fill in each blank with 연장 or 입주: ① 공사가 끝나서 드디어 새 아파트에 ____했어요. ② 회사 일 때문에 6개월 더 살아야 해서 계약을 ____했어요.
Answer in Korean with one word: 이사 들어갈 때 집주인에게 맡기고, 이사 나갈 때 다시 돌려받는 돈은 뭐예요?
Write the word (시설 / 계약서 / 관리비) that matches each description: ① 엘리베이터, 주차장, 놀이터 같은 것 ② 집세와 계약 기간이 적혀 있는 종이 ③ 청소와 경비 때문에 매달 내는 돈
answers: ① 시설 ② 계약서 ③ 관리비
